notes.title: Steam Page Released !
notes.content:
[h1]My Journey to This Moment: A Dream Realized[/h1]

Today is a monumental day for me, one filled with an incredible mix of excitement and profound relief. After countless hours, endless cups of coffee, and navigating the thrilling rollercoaster of game development, I'm absolutely ecstatic to announce that the Steam page for my passion project, [b]Insomnium[/b], is officially live!

This isn't just a game; it's a piece of my heart poured into every line of code, every creepy sound effect, and every terrifying encounter. The vision for a cooperative survival horror experience, where players truly depend on each other to brave a nightmare, has been a driving force for a long time. Seeing it come to fruition, seeing it on Steam where players can finally discover it, is a feeling I can barely put into words. It’s the culmination of so much hard work, late nights, and the unwavering belief that this game had to be made.

I’ve meticulously crafted Insomnium to be an experience that[b] truly tests teamwork[/b] and communication. The terror isn't just from the monsters; it's from the fear of making a mistake that could cost your team everything. I can't wait for you all to experience the tension, the strategic decisions, and the sheer dread that awaits you and your friends. Thank you for being a part of this journey. Now, let’s face the darkness together!My Journey to This Moment: [b]A Dream Realized
